note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list as PlayStation publishes it. Every guide below is written in this entry's own words; the steps draw on the named guides and never copy their text. Where the guides disagree or have not confirmed a step yet, the entry says so instead of inventing one.

platinum.cheats: cheats disable trophies and saving (GTABase, TechWiser) — keep them off
platinum.online: none — every trophy is offline single-player
platinum.saves: there is no mission replay, so keep a manual save at the start and end of every chapter (PowerPyx)

trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 are yours. There is no extra task behind it — finish everything else and it is free.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Gone Fishing is the opening mission: play through it as the story directs and the trophy pops at the end. If you are hunting the platinum, this is where it starts — nothing to prepare.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
steps: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, to the end.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish every mission in Chapter 1 and it pops with the chapter's end. Do the missable check in this chapter first: during Chapter 1, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house one morning and accept the meditation prompt — it is the one thing in the game that may not come back (see Positive Mental Attitude).
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
steps: Finish all Chapter 1 missions.
Before the chapter ends, do the balcony meditation with Lucia (see trophy 28).

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Play through Chapter 2 to its end. Once Chapter 2 is done, Jason and Lucia can be played together, which the last meditation spot needs.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
steps: Finish all Chapter 2 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 3 and the trophy pops. Keep your manual save habit going: one save at the start of the chapter, one at the end.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
steps: Finish all Chapter 3 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Finish Chapter 4. By now most of the map is open, so it is a good moment to start clearing the long counters — stunts, vehicles, WAiNK spots — between story beats.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
steps: Finish all Chapter 4 missions.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable, and the only hidden gold. Finish the final mission and it pops. After the ending, free roam stays open, so everything not yet done can still be finished — the only thing that cannot wait is the Chapter 1 meditation (see trophy 28).
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
steps: Finish the final mission.
After the credits, keep playing in free roam for the cleanup trophies.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Breakfast Run is a story mission; complete it and the trophy pops. No preparation needed.
trophies.name: Trust
steps: Complete the story mission Breakfast Run.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete The Cartel Heist. Heist missions tend to throw a 4-star wanted level at you, which also helps Hot Together if your partner is with you — but do not force it; the trophy itself just needs the mission done.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
steps: Complete the story mission The Cartel Heist.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the story mission Child's Play.
trophies.name: Family Matters
steps: Complete the story mission Child's Play.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the story mission Headliners.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
steps: Complete the story mission Headliners.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown. The airport comes back later for Catch Me If You Can, so remember the layout.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
steps: Complete the story mission VCIA Takedown.

trophies.guide: Story trophy, unmissable. Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
steps: Complete the story mission Operation Savage Glory.

trophies.guide: The hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The 100% checklist (Progress, then Stats, then 100% Completion) appears after the story, but everything you did earlier already counts, and nothing on it is missable. PowerPyx puts it at roughly 60% of true completion: most side quests are not required and collectibles only partly. It asks for 300 stunts and 15 of the 18 meditation spots, so even a missed Chapter 1 meditation cannot cost you this trophy.
trophies.name: A Long Road
steps: Finish the story to reveal the 100% checklist.
Work the checklist in free roam: missions, activities, collectibles and the counters it names.
Check the Progress menu often — it tracks every category for you.

trophies.guide: Any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game count, and the 100% checklist asks for 300, so keep going past this one. Stunts are the jumps, airtime and near-miss feats the game tracks as you drive and ride — play naturally and the counter climbs, then mop up the marked stunt jumps late in the game.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
steps: Do stunt jumps and driving feats anywhere in Leonida.
Track the count in the Progress menu; the 100% checklist wants 300.
trophies.time: a few hours across the game

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: There are 9 activity types. You do not need to be good at any of them — one try at each is enough. A natural early-game trophy: as each new activity opens up (fishing, races, shooting range, arcade, bowling, drone races and the rest), try it once and move on.
trophies.name: Master of None
steps: Try each of the 9 activity types once.
New activities unlock as you play; the Progress menu shows which you have tried.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Gold all 42 Shooting Range challenges across the 12 ranges. This is a skill trophy, not a grind: learn each range's pattern, use the right weapon for the drill, and replay a challenge until the gold time or score lands. Leave it until your aim and weapon handling are upgraded, then work range by range.
trophies.name: The Shootist
steps: Visit a shooting range and try its challenges.
Gold all 42 challenges across the 12 ranges.
Replay any challenge as often as needed — there is no penalty for failing.

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Each location is its own short course: learn the gates, cut corners where the course allows, and do not be afraid to restart a race after a bad start — a win is a win, and the trophy only counts wins, one per location.
trophies.name: Top Fun
steps: Find the 14 Top Fun drone race locations.
Win one race at each.

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different events, not the same one 20 times. Road races, off-road and the other race types all count. Pick a fast car you like, learn the starts, and work through the race list; wins in story and side races count too.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
steps: Enter races around Leonida.
Win 20 different race events.

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Find a fishing challenge and beat Cal at it. Fishing is one of the activities: pick a fishing spot, use the right approach for the fish on offer, and outscore Cal. If you lose, just challenge him again — the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
steps: Find a fishing spot and take the fishing challenge against Cal.
Out-fish him once.

trophies.guide: Finish any one arcade game, start to end. Arcade machines are scattered around Leonida — pick a game you like, play it through, and the trophy pops when the credits roll. It also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
steps: Find an arcade machine.
Play one arcade game to completion.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy, unmissable in free roam but tied to story progress: Andy's mission strand opens as you play, and the trophy pops when you finish his last mission. Stranger chains have windows tied to story progress (TechWiser), so take Andy's missions when they appear rather than leaving them all to the end.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
steps: Take Andy's stranger missions when they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Kenton's strand opens during the story and he goes quiet for a while mid-game, so do not worry if his missions dry up — they come back. Finish his final mission and the trophy pops.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
steps: Take Kenton's stranger missions when they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Work through Billy's mission strand as it appears and finish his last mission. Like the other stranger strands, it is tied to story progress, so keep checking back between story beats.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
steps: Take Billy's stranger missions when they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 full stranger mission strands — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone, Bret and the rest. Each strand is a short chain of missions for one character; the trophy pops when the eighth strand is done. These strands are not part of the 100% checklist, so they are easy to leave behind: track them here and do a strand whenever its giver appears.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
steps: Take stranger missions whenever a new giver appears.
Complete 8 full strands.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Finish Randy's mission strand with his final mission. Take his missions when they appear — stranger chains follow story progress.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
steps: Take Randy's stranger missions when they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Finish Tyrone's mission strand with his final mission. Take his missions when they appear — stranger chains follow story progress.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
steps: Take Tyrone's stranger missions when they appear.
Complete his final mission.

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE TROPHY YOU CAN MISS. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, using both Jason and Lucia. The first meditation is Lucia's: during Chapter 1, one morning she mentions meditation in the kitchen at Jason's house and heads out to the balcony — follow her, accept the prompt, and she shows you how it works. That balcony is not marked as a Meditation Spot like the others, and it is gone after Chapter 1. Nobody has confirmed whether the trophy actually requires it — PowerPyx's author did it and then earned the trophy — so do it. The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together, which opens after Chapter 2. Safety net: the 100% checklist only asks for 15 of the 18 spots, so a missed Chapter 1 meditation cannot cost you A Long Road.
trophies.missable_note: Do the Chapter 1 balcony meditation with Lucia before Chapter 1 ends. Unconfirmed whether it is required — do it anyway.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
steps: Chapter 1: follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and meditate when prompted.
Meditate at the other 17 spots across Leonida (10 locations).
The last spot needs Jason and Lucia playable together (after Chapter 2).
Watch the meditation counter in the Progress menu.

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Stranger trophy. Bret sends you after a unique animal — which animal is still unconfirmed in the guides, so expect a hunt, not a checklist item. Take Bret's missions as they appear, follow his lead to the animal, and take it down as he asks.
trophies.name: Fair Game
steps: Take Bret's stranger missions when they appear.
Hunt the unique animal he points you to.

trophies.guide: Collectible cards are hidden around Leonida in sets. Complete any 3 full sets. Cards are a long hunt: grab them as you pass through areas rather than saving them all for the end, and use the in-game tracking to see which sets are still short.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
steps: Pick up collectible cards around Leonida.
Complete 3 full sets.

trophies.guide: WAiNK It is the in-game photo/scan feature: point it at new things at 100 different locations. It overlaps with exploring — scan vehicles, landmarks and oddities as you travel, and the counter climbs. The 100% checklist does not ask for all of it, so treat it as a side hunt between story missions.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
steps: Use WAiNK It on new subjects as you explore.
Reach 100 locations.
trophies.time: a few hours across the game

trophies.guide: Challenges are the small feats the game tracks everywhere — driving, combat, exploration and more. Fifty of them, any fifty. They complete naturally while you play; if you are short late in the game, open the challenge list and pick off the easy ones you have nearly finished.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
steps: Play the game — challenges complete as you go.
Open the challenge list late in the game and finish 50.

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner alongside, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape. It often pops on its own: robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level (GameMapa), so do Maximum Withdrawal with your partner and this may follow. Otherwise, cause chaos with your partner nearby, then break line of sight, switch cars, and hide until the stars clear.
trophies.name: Hot Together
steps: Play with your partner alongside.
Reach a 4-star wanted level, then lose the cops and escape.

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level — the trick is the 'without losing' part: you must keep the heat the whole time. Plan a route of three close shops, hit them fast one after another, and do not let the wanted level drop to zero between them. If the stars clear, the chain breaks and you start over.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
steps: Play with your partner alongside.
Pick three shops close together.
Rob all three in a row without the wanted level clearing.

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — any car, bike, boat or aircraft you have not seen before counts when you get close to it. It fills up naturally as you explore, and faster if you deliberately tour new areas and vehicle spawns. WAiNK scanning helps you notice new ones.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
steps: Explore new areas and approach vehicles you have not seen.
Reach 100 discovered vehicles.

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Combat Focus slows time and lets you line up shots — the trophy needs 5 takedowns in one activation. Set it up: go somewhere with a group of enemies close together, buff your focus first if you can, then trigger Combat Focus and drop five before it ends. A busy shootout is your best chance; do not waste it on a lone enemy.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
steps: Find a fight with a group of enemies together.
Trigger Combat Focus and take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a plane at Vice City International Airport and leave without permission. GTABase reports the way: take a docked passenger jet — the one at terminals E3/E4 (games.gg) — get into the cockpit, reverse toward the runway and take off, then fly about a kilometre away from the airport for the delayed unlock. Expect heavy airport security on the way in.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
steps: Go to VCIA and reach a docked passenger jet (terminals E3/E4).
Get in, reach the cockpit, reverse to the runway and take off.
Fly about 1 km from the airport.

trophies.guide: Get inside a Rhino tank and cause chaos. GTABase reports the way: steal a tank from Mile Zero Air Station, then take out enemies from inside it. The trophy's own description is a joke with no instructions, so expect a fight getting in and out — bring a plan for the military response.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
steps: Reach Mile Zero Air Station.
Steal a Rhino tank and take out enemies from inside it.

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: A stealth robbery: get into a jewelry store, take the goods, and get out without anyone raising the alarm. Plan it like a heist — case the store, go when it is quiet, keep your weapon out of sight until you need it, and leave before the police are called. Being spotted fails the attempt, not the trophy, so you can retry.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
steps: Pick a jewelry store and watch its routine.
Rob it without being detected.

trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and escape each time. Vaults are the big robberies: plan the approach, bring your partner if you want Hot Together to pop along the way (a vault robbery instantly gives a 4-star wanted level, per GameMapa), and have an escape route ready before you go in. Five vaults, five clean getaways.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
steps: Find bank vaults to rob.
Rob 5 vaults and escape after each.

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida. Stop one — block the road or hit it hard enough to make it stop — rob it, then escape the wanted level that follows. Trucks are easiest on a quiet stretch of road where you control the approach and the getaway.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
steps: Find an armored truck on its route.
Stop it, rob it, and escape.

trophies.guide: Visit all 52 areas of Leonida. The map tracks where you have been — the trick is the corners you never had a reason to visit. Work through the map region by region, driving the back roads and the coastline, and check the explored count in the Progress menu to find the gaps.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
steps: Travel through all 52 areas of Leonida.
Use the Progress menu to find areas you have not visited.

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: There are 9 gangs, each running illegal operations around Leonida. Rob one operation per gang — nine robberies in total. Learn which corners belong to whom, hit one operation for each gang, and get out clean. The operations are spread out, so this pairs well with exploring the map for The Goodtime State.
trophies.name: Pest Control
steps: Find an illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs.
Rob one operation per gang.

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Not yet solved by the guides. The description is plain — have a cocktail somewhere with a view on Ocean Beach — but PowerPyx marks the exact spot as not yet known (EGamers). Head to the Ocean Beach waterfront bars, order a cocktail, and enjoy the view; if it does not pop, try another bar along the beach. This entry will not invent a spot the guides have not confirmed.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
steps: Go to the Ocean Beach waterfront.
Have a cocktail at a bar with a view. Exact spot unconfirmed — see Sources.

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Not yet solved by the guides. GTABase thinks it means crashing a car out through a showroom window, but that is unconfirmed (EGamers), and PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. The classic-style hint points to driving a car straight out through the glass of a vehicle showroom — try that, and expect the guides to pin it down soon.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
steps: Take a car into a vehicle showroom.
Drive it out through the glass, in classic style. Exact method unconfirmed — see Sources.

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go bowling at the Kolt & Associates alley and follow through — finish a game there. Bowling is one of the activities, so it also counts toward Master of None. A relaxed one: book a lane, bowl your frames, and the trophy pops when the game ends.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a game of bowling to the end.

trophies.guide: GTABase reports this one is about Strength: max out the Strength stat for both Jason and Lucia. Train both characters — gyms, sports and the activities that build Strength — until both are maxed, and the trophy should pop. Single source, so treat the method as reported rather than confirmed.
trophies.name: Personal Best
steps: Train Strength for Jason and for Lucia.
Max it out for both characters.

trophies.guide: GTABase links this to the Criminal Profile: 500 actions that change your profile. Robberies and enemy encounters contribute naturally (games.gg), so do not grind it early — play the game, make choices, and the count climbs on its own. Check your Criminal Profile to see where you stand, and mop up late if you are short. Single-source count, so the number may be refined.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
steps: Play the game and make choices — robberies and fights count.
Reach 500 profile-changing actions (GTABase).

trophies.guide: Not yet solved by the guides — PowerPyx marks it as not yet known (EGamers). The name says it all: succeed at something on the second try. Keep playing; it will likely pop when you retry something you just failed, whether a mission, a challenge or a minigame. This entry will not invent the trigger.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
steps: Fail something, then succeed on the second try. Exact trigger unconfirmed — see Sources.

trophies.guide: Not yet solved by the guides. GTABase thinks it refers to a strange event somewhere in Leonida, but that is unconfirmed (EGamers), and PowerPyx lists it as not yet known. Explore the odd corners of the map — the strange encounters are out there — and this one should pop when you witness one. This entry will not invent the event.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
steps: Explore Leonida's odd corners and witness a strange event. Exact event unconfirmed — see Sources.

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. PowerPyx marks the exact setup as not yet known (EGamers), but the description is clear enough: get a vehicle moving, get close to someone on foot, and swing a melee weapon as you pass. A slow drive-by past a lone pedestrian is the safest attempt.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
steps: Get a vehicle moving near someone on foot.
Hit them with a melee attack from the vehicle as you pass.

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Marked Bills come from robberies — you cannot spend them as they are. Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean. It is a slow earner by design: keep robbing, keep laundering, and the total adds up across the game. Laundered money is also how you fund the big purchases for Treat Yo Self and Little Boxes.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 in total across all shops — clothes, weapons, food, anything. It counts cumulatively, so normal play gets you most of the way there. Late in the game, top it up with a shopping spree: expensive clothes and weapon upgrades are the fastest way to close the gap.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
steps: Shop as you play — everything counts.
Top up with expensive purchases if you are short.

trophies.guide: Buy all 8 garage properties around Leonida. Garages are bought, not found — save up (laundered money helps) and buy them as they become available. Each one also gives you somewhere to store the vehicles you discover for Whip It Good.
trophies.name: Little Boxes
steps: Save up — laundering Marked Bills helps.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Find vehicles you have discovered, open the app, and register them — ten different vehicles, any ten. It pairs naturally with Whip It Good: every new vehicle you discover is one you can register.
trophies.name: On the Spot
steps: Discover vehicles around Leonida.
Register 10 of them in the Scooter Bros app.
